newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Natwest ups Parker-Hannifin.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Natwest ups Parker-Hannifin.

text.p: -- NatWest Securities analyst Thomas Burns said he upgraded Parker-Hannifin Corp to buy from hold and set a new price target of $55 on the stock.
-- The analyst said he nudged up his second quarter 1997 earnings estimate by a penny to $0.68 per share, but his projections for the rest of 1997 and 1998 in place.
-- He said he expected 1997 to a year of improving econonmic activity in the major countries of Europe leading to a modest five percent rise in Parker-Hannifin's international sales in fiscal 1998.
-- The analyst forecast a 59 percent growth in fiscal 1998 profits for Parker's Industrial International operations.

-- Burns said that over the past 12 to 18 months, the company has weathered a weak economic cycle, and largely resolved issues of excess inventories in some of its product lines and some capacity shortages.
-- He said modestly improving business demand should allow for significant earnings gains beginning in the fourth quarter ended June 1997.
